# Nord CE5 GSI fixes

KernelSU / Magisk module that makes **GSIs** (TrebleDroid based) usable on the
**OnePlus Nord CE5** (CPH2719, codename OP613BL1, MediaTek MT6897).

## ⬇️ Download

**[OP613BL1-GSI-fixes-v3.zip](https://github.com/xantre1337/nord-ce5-gsi-fixes/releases/latest/download/OP613BL1-GSI-fixes-v3.zip)**
(all versions: [Releases](https://github.com/xantre1337/nord-ce5-gsi-fixes/releases))

Only one phone and can't log in to Telegram inside the GSI? Open the link above in the GSI's browser.

## What it fixes

| | |
|---|---|
| 👆 Under-display fingerprint | Without it the GSI thinks the sensor is in the power button and fingerprint unlock doesn't work |
| 📱 Display overlay | Camera cutout, status bar height and icon paddings, rounded corners, lockscreen text kept above the sensor |

## Install

1. Boot the GSI ([DSU Sideloader](https://github.com/VegaBobo/DSU-Sideloader) works fine)
2. KernelSU / Magisk → Modules → Install from storage → pick the zip
3. Reboot

Check that it worked:

```
adb shell su -c cat /dev/op613bl1_gsi_fixes.log
```

should print `fp: mounted` and `ovl: mounted`.

## Notes

- **GSI only.** The module refuses to install on OxygenOS / ColorOS.
- It checks `ro.boot.prjname=24891` (CPH2719). Other CE5 variants may use a different project id; open an issue with the output of `getprop ro.boot.prjname`.
- Tested on Infinity X 3.12 (Doze-off, Android 16 QPR2) via DSU with KernelSU Next. Magisk is not tested yet.
- Known issue: a small cosmetic glitch around the fingerprint icon on the lockscreen.
- Tip: if the notification shade lags, turn off blur in the GSI settings for a smooth 120 fps.

## How it works

Newer KernelSU only mounts a module's `system/` through a metamodule, and init can't execute files from `/data`
(nosuid → SELinux `nosuid_transition` denial). So `post-fs-data.sh` mounts everything itself, from tmpfs:

- **Fingerprint.** The Oplus HAL (`vendor.oplus.hardware.biometrics.fingerprint@2.1-service_uff`, AIDL
  `IFingerprint` V3) reports the sensor without the under-display location. A copy of the HAL gets one more
  `DT_NEEDED` entry (`patchelf --add-needed`) for the LineageOS SensorProps shim, which fills in the optical UDFPS
  type, location and size from `persist.vendor.fingerprint.optical.*`. The copy is bind-mounted over the original,
  only if the original matches the expected SHA-256.
- **Overlays.** Two static RROs (`android`, `com.android.systemui`) with the values from the stock CE5 overlays,
  gated on `ro.boot.prjname=24891`, are overlay-mounted into `/system/product/overlay`.

## Building

```
# work/: framework-res.apk (from the GSI), the stock HAL (from /odm/bin/hw), the shim .so
#        (shim/ built in an AOSP tree: m libshims_aidl_fingerprint_v3.oplus)
AAPT2=... APKSIGNER=... KEY=.../security/platform tools/build.sh
```

See the header of `tools/build.sh` for details.

## Credits

- [LineageOS](https://github.com/LineageOS) for the Oplus SensorProps shim (`shim/`, Apache-2.0)
- [TrebleDroid](https://github.com/TrebleDroid) and [Doze-off](https://github.com/Doze-off) for the GSIs
- Maintainers: xantre & Claude

Also by us: [OrangeFox Recovery for the Nord CE5](https://github.com/xantre1337/android_device_oneplus_OP613BL1)
